seo.title: Building Cost-Effective Serverless Apps on AWS | Data Pulse
seo.description: Learn how to architect serverless applications on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB.

sidebar.quote: Serverless is not about no servers; it is about no idle servers.

content.section1_p1: Traditional infrastructure charges you for uptime; serverless charges you for execution. This shift requires a new architectural mental model.
content.section1_p2_cont: Trigger logic only when needed to minimize waste.
content.callout_text: Using Lambda layers to share logic across hundreds of micro-functions.
content.section2_p1: Single-table design patterns ensure high performance and low latency even at massive scale.
